rubric.adequate: one-word tag preserves the main intent well enough to navigate a flamegraph bucket
rubric.generic_noisy: grammatical but too broad or visually noisy
rubric.misleading: points to the wrong action, object, or task

success_criteria.strong_final_labels: all packet rows must be consensus or adjudicated, not single-label
success_criteria.paired_labels: all packet rows must have labeler_1 and labeler_2 before adjudication

claim_boundary: C6 semantic adequacy requires real human labels and agreement/adjudication
